## Why visit

One of the strongest Wirral choices for cider and unhurried pub conversation. Two small rooms, breweriana and local artwork make the former shop feel personal, while the operator emphasises traditional drinks over screens and entertainment. CAMRA’s recent cider awards give a concrete reason to take the detour, and its description of a dark-beer option is welcome for drinkers tired of pale-only selections. Make this a planned destination rather than assuming it lies beside a station or the New Brighton seafront.
